name: Alphabet
thesis: Search cash engine remains intact-but-decelerating (still funds the model); the actual investment thesis is (1) GCP margin and revenue expansion catching up to AWS/Azure, (2) Gemini distribution capturing AI query share before search cannibalization compounds, (3) capex absorption — capex must produce visible ROI through cloud margin expansion or compute-as-a-service revenue, (4) Other Bets discipline (Waymo commercializing, burn bounded), with optionality from key private equity stakes (SpaceX, Anthropic).
key_driver: GCP revenue acceleration to 50%+ + Waymo commercialization trajectory

tier_1_kpis.name: GCP revenue growth (YoY)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <50% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs through end of 2027 (thesis statement: GCP must accelerate from current ~30s%, not just stay flat)

tier_1_kpis.name: GCP operating margin trajectory
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Margin expansion stalls QoQ or contracts (vs AWS ~35%, Azure implied 40%+)

tier_1_kpis.name: Capex / cloud-revenue ratio + AI ROI commentary
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Capex/cloud rev rising while GCP margin not expanding (the 'spending without payoff' signal)

tier_1_kpis.name: Other Bets operating loss + Waymo revenue growth
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Other Bets loss expanding YoY without Waymo revenue at least 2x'ing annually; OR Waymo revenue growth <100% YoY (still in scale-up phase, anything slower means commercialization is stalling)

tier_2_kpis.name: YouTube ads revenue growth (demoted from T1)
Gemini API token volume / API revenue (when disclosed)
Paid click growth vs price-per-click decoupling
Subscriptions, platforms & devices revenue (YT Premium, One)

tier_3_kpis.name: SpaceX equity stake mark
tier_3_kpis.notes: Bottom of the list; monitor only

tier_3_kpis.name: Anthropic equity stake mark
tier_3_kpis.notes: Bottom of the list; monitor only

nuance.bear_case: GCP at 50%+ for 2 years is an aggressive bar — current ~30s% growth means the company needs material acceleration, not just maintenance. If hyperscalers normalize cloud growth into the 30s% (as is common at $50B+ scale), this thesis trips even though GCP is doing well by industry standards. ChatGPT/Perplexity sustained search-share takings would compound the cannibalization risk.
nuance.adversarial_take: Capex compounding without GCP margin expansion creates a 2027 margin shock — the AI infrastructure build is 2-3 years ahead of monetization. DOJ remedy uncertainty (Chrome/Android divestiture) is a long-tail tail risk that's hard to size but binary in outcome.
nuance.stress_test: If GCP prints below 50% for 2 Qs while capex/cloud-rev ratio rises, the 'AI ROI is coming' argument loses credibility and forces a multiple re-rate.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: DOJ remedy forces Chrome or Android divestiture
ChatGPT sustained >1B WAU with monetized ad model
Apple defaults away from Google Search on iOS
Other Bets loss expanding faster than Waymo revenue 2x trajectory

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Search ads CC growth < 8% YoY for 2Q — AI-disruption thesis-breaker; Search remains the core profit pool.
GCP revenue YoY < 25% for 2Q — Cloud catch-up vs MSFT/AWS thesis breaks.
GCP op margin < 15% — Cloud profitability inflection reverses.
Consolidated op margin < 28% — TAC pressure or capex bloat compressing the profit engine (Q1-Q3 run rate ~33%).
